title: Nike and Kids Of Immigrants Return With a New Footwear Collection for the Football Pitch and Streets
summary: Nike and Kids Of Immigrants continue to celebrate football as a universal language, connecting cultures and generations in a new footwear collaboration that brings the global communities of both brands together through the beautiful game.
body_markdown:
Nike and Kids Of Immigrants are back with a new footwear collaboration that connects cultures and generations through football.


Drawing inspiration from the mountainous landscape of Honduras and Liberia, the homelands of Kids Of Immigrants founders Daniel Buezo and Weleh Dennis, exclusive expressions of the[Nike Tiempo Maestro Elite and Nike Tiempo Streetgato](https://about.nike.com/en/newsroom/releases/nike-football-tiempo-maestro-official-images) connect two places on opposite sides of the world through the universal language of football.


Vibrant yellow brings joy, energy and confidence to both silhouettes, as archival Nike Football references meet Kids Of Immigrants’ creative lens.


Built for the pitch, the Tiempo Maestro Elite features FlyTouch leather for touch and control, while the Streetgato extends the story beyond the field, moving effortlessly between football and everyday life.


The collection marks the first time Nike and Kids Of Immigrants have brought their partnership to performance football footwear, following collaborations across the Air Max Sunder, T90 and[Nike Toma el Juego experiences](https://www.nike.com/toma) .


The Nike Tiempo Maestro Elite x Kids Of Immigrants and Nike Tiempo Streetgato x Kids Of Immigrants will be available at the Kids Of Immigrants flagship location in Los Angeles on November 7 before launching at[kidsofimmigrants.us](https://kidsofimmigrants.us/) on November 17. The collection will be available globally November 19 across[SNKRS](https://www.nike.com/launch) ,[nike.com](https://www.nike.com/) and select retail locations.
